plan.title: feat(check,telemetry): telemetry-coverage dead-surface detector - every event kind needs a production caller and a field-shaped fixture

narratives.Description: task check does not fail when a run-summary event kind has no production caller or no field fixture. Emitters can ship silent while gates stay green.
narratives.Overview:
**TL;DR: gates fail loudly, emitters fail silently. The last release shipped every gate correctly and three telemetry surfaces unwired: tool_turn_denominator with zero production callers (#3356), acceptance events silent across a full field trial (#3355), seqSeed with zero callers plus per-process session_id (#3350). Nothing in the framework check list fails when an event never fires, so nothing in the swarm quality loop can catch this class. One deterministic gate closes it: a dead-surface detector.**

## The gate (composed into the framework check list)

Two static checks, one remediation:

1. **No dead event kinds.** Every kind in RUN_SUMMARY_EVENT_KINDS (and every exported emitter method) has at least one production call site outside the emitter module. Would have caught tool_turn_denominator and seqSeed on the PR that shipped them.
2. **Every event kind has a field-shaped fixture.** A shared integration harness runs a fake trial (temp consumer deposit, real verb sequence, DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH set) and reads the JSONL back. Each kind must be asserted present by at least one fixture test. The harness is the reusable piece. #3355's acceptance sketch demands the first instance. This issue generalizes it. This half also catches the subtler failures static analysis cannot: call sites that exist but never execute on real paths (the #3355 case), and per-process identity resets (#3350 seq/session_id — the fixture asserts monotonic seq and a stable session_id across a multi-invocation trial).

Remediation string names the missing half: event kind k has no production caller / no field fixture — wire it or remove it from the schema.

## How it reaches the swarm

No prompt or checklist text is load-bearing: drive-to-merge-ready workers must pass the framework check list, so landing the gate enrolls every future worker automatically. Companion prose (explanation tier, not enforcement): one MUST/⊗ pair in content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md and CONTRIBUTING — a telemetry deliverable is not done until a fixture reads its events from a fake trial. Silence is the failure mode this gate exists for. Framework-internal dev process only — NOT consumer-relevant, so no agents-entry propagation under #1309.

## Acceptance sketch

- The framework check list warns (later fails) on a branch that adds a schema event kind with no caller, or an emitter method with no fixture asserting its output.
- The fake-trial harness exists once and is extended per kind, not rebuilt.
- Gate ships warn-only for one release if the existing debt (#3355/#3356/#3350 fixes in flight) would hard-block, then fail-closed.

Relates #3355, #3356, #3350 (the three instances), #3320/#3323/#3319 (shipped kinds this retroactively covers), #3265 (thin fail-closed), #3156 (the gate tests the telemetry, never the reverse), #954/#1309 (propagation discipline — explicitly not consumer-facing).
narratives.UserStory: As a framework maintainer, I want the telemetry-coverage verifier inside the framework check list, so that dead event kinds fail in the same loop as every other gate.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add packages/core/src/telemetry-coverage (or packages/core/src/verify/telemetry-coverage.ts) with two checks: every RUN_SUMMARY_EVENT_KINDS / exported emitter method has a production caller, and each kind has a field-shaped fixture on a shared fake-trial harness. Wire the telemetry-coverage verifier in tasks/verify.yml into the framework check list. Ship warn-only this release because #3355/#3356 are in the same wave. Companion MUST/⊗ in content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md and CONTRIBUTING.md only; no agents-entry. Evidence: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/telemetry-coverage plus CHANGELOG #3362.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a branch that adds a schema event kind with no production caller, when task check runs the new gate, it fails (or warns in the one-release warn-only window) with a remediation that names the kind.
Given the harness exists once, when a kind is enrolled, a fixture asserts that kind appears in DEFT_RUN_SUMMARY_PATH JSONL from a fake trial.
Given the gate lands, task check (framework list) includes it, preamble and CONTRIBUTING have the MUST/⊗ pair, and CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #3362. No agents-entry edit.
